title: TUTO DANSE POUR DÉBUTANT FACILE Apprendre à danser

method.teacher_system: Super Mylo teaches beginners how to feel the groove and rhythm by starting with relaxation, counting to eight, and opening and closing the body from side to side. She breaks down weight distribution, shoulder posture, and letting go of tension before putting movements together to music. She encourages smiling, letting the body speak, and dancing without fear of judgment.

practices.what: The teacher taps the rhythm with her head and counts from one to eight repeatedly.
The teacher shakes and moves her body in all directions to let go of tension and take in the rhythm.
The teacher introduces the first exercise focusing on taking the sound and counting four sets of eight.
The teacher performs the first exercise multiple times while counting out loud from one to eight.
The teacher adds upper body movements and head positioning while continuing the step.
The teacher introduces the second exercise, counting four sets of eight while opening and closing the body.
The teacher repeats the second exercise with body displacement from right to left.
The teacher introduces the third exercise, displacing weight from side to side with alternative arm and hand movements.
The teacher performs repetitions of the third exercise at a slow pace before accelerating.

adaptations.difficulty: the footwork or arm coordination can feel complicated
adaptations.adjustment: either keep it simple by closing, cross behind, or cross in front

adaptations.difficulty: forgetting the rhythm or losing the thread while practicing alone
adaptations.adjustment: stop, breathe, and resume whenever you want

beliefs.belief: Making mistakes is a sign of progress in learning to dance.

feelings.response: The teacher acknowledges that it is normal to feel afraid of looking silly in certain positions.
The teacher notes that everyone fears looking silly in certain positions, but assures learners there is no reason to worry.
The teacher reassures the learner that no one is watching them and they should not worry about being judged.
The teacher asks the learner to relax their shoulders and not feel like they have to be stiff while moving.

moments.says: The teacher laughs at her own mistake and makes a joke about it, showing that it is okay to not be perfect.
The teacher reassures the learner that they do not need to panic if they already know how to count the music.
The teacher explains that the video is in mirror mode, so the learner should follow her movements as if looking in a mirror.
The teacher tells the learner not to worry about being seen, as no one is watching them.
The teacher encourages the learner to close their eyes and move in a relaxed way.
The teacher tells the learner that it is not a problem if they lose the rhythm, they should just stop, breathe, and start again.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling that they are already a dancer and that they can learn at their own pace.

struggles.theme: feeling like doing everything wrong and lacking confidence
fear of the gaze of others and looking ridiculous

clicked.theme: video gave renewed confidence and helped overcome clumsiness
energy and humor made it fun and accessible

requests.theme: asking for specific choreographies or tutorials like Bruno Mars

meant.theme: feeling great joy, release, and readiness for upcoming events

method.limits: The video does not show full-length student interactions or real-time feedback since it is a pre-recorded solo tutorial.
